Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, pick any mount you can ride, then face the champions in practice bouts.
13814.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
13814.reward: You handle your mount well, $N. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.

13816.title: Heroic: The Celestial Planetarium
13816.obj: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to locate the entrance to the Celestial Planetarium.
13816.desc: Listen, $glad:lass;!  Azeroth's fate is at stake here.$B$BOur only chance is to get to the Celestial Planetarium in time to find this Algalon and stop him from beaming back any messages to his Titan masters.$B$BLocate the Celestial Planetarium and come back with any information you get.  We might still have some time to prepare for Algalon's arrival.
13816.reward: It's locked?  Figures!$b$bI'll let Brann know... maybe he can uncover something in the Archivum.

13817.title: Heroic: Archivum Data Disc
13817.obj: Bring the Archivum Data Disc to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
13817.desc: This platinum disc is surprisingly symmetrical and devoid of any scratches or imperfections.  Engraved along its edge, bold runes spell out the word "ARCHIVUM."$B$BThere must be a device inside Ulduar capable of reading the disc.
13817.progress: The console whirrs with energy as the round receptacle opens.
13817.reward: The platinum disc fits perfectly inside the console. It begins to spin as its contents are scanned by white beams of light.

13818.title: Heroic: Algalon
13818.obj: Bring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
13818.desc: You really did it, $N.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$B$BYou best hurry, $g lad:lass;.  Time is of the essence.
13818.progress: The console's bright lights scan the glass surface repeatedly, as if awaiting some form of input.
13818.reward: Stand by for verification.$b$bAccess to the Celestial Planetarium granted. Please retrieve your key.

13819.title: Heroic: All Is Well That Ends Well
13819.obj: Take the Reply-Code Alpha to Rhonin in Dalaran.
13819.desc: We'd best hurry now, $N.  We're going to have to transmit the reply-code from Dalaran.$B$BTake it to Rhonin, I will meet you there.
13819.reward: You're here.  Let us hope this works.  For all our sakes.

13820.title: The Blastbolt Brothers
13820.obj: Speak with Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
13820.desc: The highlord has tasked me with getting that coliseum completed as soon as possible. We've put our own masons to work on the project, but we found out very quickly that we were going to need help procuring materials. I've hired a couple of goblins, Bezzle Blastbolt and his brother, Bozzle.$B$BThey're supervising construction at the southeastern end of the tournament grounds. Speak with Bezzle and see if he and his brother could use any more help getting the building materials we need.
13820.reward: So the justicar sent you to see us? Good, good...$b$bWe could always use more help with the, uh, "requisition" of materials.

13821.title: Heroic: Freya's Sigil
13821.obj: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Freya's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Freya's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
13821.desc: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$B$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark.  Should any of the elders be harmed, the Sigil's integrity will be compromised.$B$BSparing the elders, however, means that Freya will be more powerful when you face her.$B$BWhat can I say, $N.  We're stuck between a rock and hard place.
13821.progress: Freya's sigil, $n? Do ye have it?
13821.reward: Excellent job, $N. We're one step closer to saving Azeroth!

13822.title: Heroic: Hodir's Sigil
13822.obj: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
13822.desc: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$B$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!
13822.reward: Ye did it! I don't know how, but ye did!

13823.title: Heroic: Thorim's Sigil
13823.obj: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Thorim's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Thorim's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
13823.desc: Thorim's not himself, $N.  He's come under a dark influence.$B$BAn evil presence under the guise of an illusion pretends to be his lost wife, Sif.$B$BYe can't let him be overcome by this impostor's spell.  If he does, the location of his sigil might forever be lost!$B$BYer going to have to beat some sense into him and yer going to have to do it quick.$B$BAs always, the Archivum Console will give ye all the gory details... even the ones ye don't like.
13823.reward: Ye never cease to impress, $N.$b$bYe and me are having a pint together after all this is done, ye hear me?

13824.title: Heroic: Mimiron's Sigil
13824.obj: Prospector Loren at the Ulduar Archivum wants you to obtain Mimiron's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Mimiron's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
13824.desc: Mimiron's a clever one.  His entire abode is rigged with some sort of self-destruction mechanism.$B$BUnfortunately yer gonna have to race against it if ye want to get his sigil.  Check the Archivum Console for more details if ye need them.
13824.progress: Were you able to obtain the sigil, $n?
13824.reward: I've got to hand it to you, $N. Our odds might not be the best, but I feel a lot better with you lending a hand.

13828.title: Mastery Of Melee
13828.obj: Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
13828.desc: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.
13828.progress: Did you speak to Jeran Lockwood and practice close range mounted melee?
13828.reward: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.

13829.title: Mastery Of Melee
13829.obj: Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
13829.desc: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.
13829.progress: Did you speak to Jeran Lockwood and practice close range mounted melee?
13829.reward: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.

13830.title: The Ghostfish
13830.obj: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to discover the mystery of the Phantom Ghostfish.
13830.desc: Any Northrend angler worth $ghis:her; salt knows about the pygmy suckerfish.  It's not edible, but sometimes useful to alchemists.$b$bThere is, however, a stealthy fish that hides among the suckerfish in the River's Heart of Sholazar Basin.  The phantom ghostfish.  When out of water, they become increasingly translucent until they fade away completely.  Some hypothesize they return to Sholazar, and others are more... superstitious.$b$bI want you to catch this fish and discover its secret by any means!
13830.progress: Is the ghostfish haunting your best efforts?$b$b<Marcia looks particularly proud of herself for her pun.>
13830.reward: So eating it makes you invisible... what a strange defense this clever fish has developed.$b$bI'd like to digest this for a bit. Pun not intended, $N. Really. Why don't you come see me tomorrow?

13832.title: Jewel Of The Sewers
13832.obj: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her a piece of Corroded Jewelry.
13832.desc: Hard to believe that most people fish in the Dalaran Sewers for giant rats and mutated fish.  Especially when those waters are filled with priceless jewelry - discarded by broken hearted fools, thieves, and careless drunks.$b$bThe trick is to let your hook drag the bottom and don't pull up too hard when you get something.  Try it out, $N.  I'd be willing to trade whatever you find for a few trinkets of my own.
13832.reward: Well now, that looks like it could be valuable. Difficult to know until it's cleaned up and appraised, but I'm still willing to make the trade if you are.

13833.title: Blood Is Thicker
13833.obj: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 5 Bloodtooth Frenzies.
13833.desc: The bloodtooth is a feisty little fish used in a recipe to cure infected wounds.  We could use some of them, if you're up to it.$b$bAs the name suggests, they've a hunger for blood.  The only way I know how to catch the little devils is by creating a blood pool and fishing in it.$b$bGet yourself covered in blood - just slaughter a beast in the Borean Tundra - and then jump in the water.  It'll wash right off and create the perfect fishing spot.
13833.progress: Any luck with the bloodtooth?  Don't forget what I told you about making blood pools.
13833.reward: You are a brave one, $N.  I hope you didn't lose any extremities making your fishing spot.  If you've still got the fishing bug, come back tomorrow and we'll talk some more.

13834.title: Dangerously Delicious
13834.obj: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 10 Terrorfish.
13834.desc: The best fishing is often the most dangerous.  Wintergrasp boasts a bountiful catch for the brazen.$b$bIn fact, it's the only place to catch the fabled Terrorfish - a fish both lethal and delicious.  Bring me some, and we'll have something to discuss.
13834.progress: Be on your guard when you're after the Terrorfish.
13834.reward: My, my, my! You've caught yourself some Terrorfish. Why, that reminds me of the time...$b$b<Marcia regales you with stories of adventure and fishing for as long as you're willing to listen.>

13835.title: Mastery Of The Shield-Breaker
13835.obj: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Valis Windchaser and use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, then return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
13835.desc: You'll need to learn how to break through an opponent's defenses to succeed in mounted combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Valis Windchaser. He'll be on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Valis will teach you the basics of using a ranged shield breaker attack to make a ranged target vulnerable.
13835.progress: Have you practiced using your shield-breaker?
13835.reward: Commit Valis's lesson to memory, $N. It will mean the difference between winning and losing your mounted combat matches.

13836.title: Disarmed!
13836.obj: Olisarra the Kind in Dalaran City wants you to return the Severed Arm to her.
13836.desc: I've received word of an unfortunate accident at the Dalaran prison; a guard had his arm severed and thrown into the water by a particularly vicious inmate.$b$bOur first aid clinic promises they can reattach the arm if we bring it back.$b$bYou fish long enough in the water outside the prison, and I'd bet my favorite fishing pole that arm will surface.  Find that arm, and bring it to Olisarra the Kind here in Dalaran.  She'll know what to do.
13836.progress: Hi there.  Do you have something for me?
13836.reward: Oh, hello there $N.  Marcia said you'd be coming by with that poor man's missing arm.$b$bShe also gave me this bag to give you as a reward.  It smells horrible, and I'm anxious to make the trade if you don't mind.

13837.title: Mastery Of The Charge
13837.obj: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Rugan Steelbelly and Charge 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, then return to Avareth Swiftstrike at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
13837.desc: Your strongest attack in mounted combat is undoubtedly the charge. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, speak with Rugan Steelbelly. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Rugan will tell you how to use this powerful ability and teach you some basic strategies.
13837.progress: Have you mastered the use of the charge?
13837.reward: With a teacher like Rugan, you'll be an expert at mounted combat in no time.

13840.title: REUSE
13840.obj: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it,/cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.
13840.desc: "Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!$B$BCluck... cluck... cluck."$B$BThe chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word,but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask,the chicken turns away and goes about its business.

13843.title: The Scrapbot Construction Kit
13843.obj: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
13843.desc: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.
13843.reward: You take note of the information displayed in the schematic and the materials required to construct the scrapbot kit.

13845.title: Sealed Vial of Poison
13845.obj: Bring the Seal Vial of Poison to Alchemist Cinesra in the Dalaran Sewers.
13845.desc: This vial of poison looks particularly dangerous.  Perhaps someone in Dalaran might be interested in it.
13845.progress: Is that what I think it is, $c?
13845.reward: You are brave to have carried this.  If even one drop were to touch your skin, you'd have died an agonizing death.$b$bAllow me to pay you for it... I can always use venom of exceptional potency.

13846.title: Contributin' To The Cause
13846.obj: Speak with Squire Artie to contribute 10 gold to the Argent Crusade's cause.
13846.desc: The bestest of the champions come to the chapel to hear the argent confessor speak every day.$B$BYou should see how much she inspires them, $N. Not only do they fight for the Argent Crusade, but they put a lot of money into the collection basket when I take it around.$B$BMaybe you'd like to contribute too?
13846.reward: Thank you. I just know the crusade will put it to good use!

13847.title: At The Enemy's Gates
13847.obj: Captain Joseph Holley at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, and 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
13847.desc: Even as we ready for the tournament, Argent Crusade forces prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's minions.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
13847.progress: Have served alongside the crusaders in the Court of Bones?
13847.reward: Your bravery on the field has shown the crusaders what they already knew -- that our warriors are more than just parade ground decorations.

13850.title: Toxic Tolerance
13850.obj: Mor'vek in Un'goro Crater claims that if you were poisoned by Venomhide Ravasaur blood 20 times, you could ride one without dying. Attack Venomhide Ravasaurs for a chance to be poisoned.
13850.desc: You want to ride a Venomhide? Then I've got bad news for you.$B$BThe Venomhide Ravasaurs, they're all poison: Poison blood, poison spit, poison skin. You climb on one, you fall off dead in a few hours.$B$BYou'd have to build up a resistance to their toxins before I sold you one, and that takes a long, LONG time... you'd need to be splashed with poisonous blood while fighting one numerous times. If you're really interested, the venomhides prefer the northern area of of the Marshlands, northwest of here.
13850.progress: Still not immune, eh? Give up. It takes too long!
13850.reward: You did it? You actually did it?!$b$bHo ho! Stubborn as my wife, you are.

13887.title: Venomhide Eggs
13887.obj: Bring 4 Venomhide Ravasaur Eggs to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands.
13887.desc: Now that you've built up an immunity to venomhide toxin, you can safely handle the animals and their eggs. Venomhides are vicious and must be trained from the moment they hatch.$B$BIf you want to ride one, you'll need an unhatched egg. Scattered throughout the Marshlands are a number of ravasaur nests. Look for the eggs with lighter colored shells -- those are the ones that will hatch venomhides.$B$BIf you bring me several of the eggs, I'll allow you to keep one and raise its hatchling, with my guidance.
13887.reward: Good work. Honestly, I'm amazed you were able to find this many. With each clutch, they seem fewer in number.$b$bI'll let you raise one of the freshly-hatched venomhides. It shouldn't be shy about letting you know what it needs.

13889.title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
13889.obj: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
13889.desc: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.
13889.progress: The hatchling cocks its head and looks at you.
13889.reward: The venomhide hatchling seems satisfied with the giant meal you've provided, but there's no way of telling when it will be hungry again.

13903.title: Gorishi Grub
13903.obj: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
13903.desc: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.
13903.progress: The hatchling cocks its head and looks at you.
13903.reward: Your venomhide hatchling flashes you a toothy smile and then settles in for a nap.

13904.title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
13904.obj: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
13904.desc: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.
13904.reward: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.

13905.title: Searing Roc Feathers
13905.obj: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.
13905.desc: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$B$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$B$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.
13905.progress: Your venomhide hatchling looks at you with anticipation.
13905.reward: The venomhide hatchling accepts the feathers and begins looking them over, holding several up to its armbands.

13906.title: They Grow Up So Fast
13906.obj: Return 20 Venomhide Baby Teeth,  the Venomhide Hatchling, 20 Runecloth, 20 Rugged Leather, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeastern part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
13906.desc: With your expert feeding and care, your venomhide hatchling will grow quickly. As they grow, their hatchling teeth will be replaced by adult teeth. If you keep the teeth shed by your hatchling as it grows, you'll have an easy way to tell when it's mature enough to be trained as a mount.$B$BYour venomhide will let you know what it needs, so pay close attention. When it has shed all of its baby teeth, return to me with your venomhide and the materials for your saddle and I'll do the rest.
13906.progress: Have you been taking good care of that raptor?
13906.reward: It looks like both of you have managed to do some growing without killing one another.$b$bThere, everything's finished. I've trained your venomhide ravasaur to respond when you blow this whistle.$b$bFew have the dedication to hand-feed and raise a venomhide, but they're well worth the effort.

13908.title: Gearing Up To Ride
13908.obj: Bring 20 Rugged Leather, 20 Runecloth, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
13908.desc: Your venomhide is strong and healthy and you've developed quite a bond. You'll be ready to ride him once I've completed your saddle and bridle. Just like you, they have to be specially conditioned to stand up to the toxins the raptor produces.$B$BAll you'll need to do is bring me some rugged leather, runecloth, and money to buy the rest of the supplies and I'll have that saddle for you in no time.
